dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Saints (3-7) Week 12 Briefing: Wednesday Injury Report Ahead of Bengals
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: OT Taliese Fuaga (knee), C Erik McCoy (biceps), and OT Asim Richards (knee) logged limited practice reps Wednesday [neworleanssaints.com Official](https://www.neworleanssaints.com/news/morning-break-erik-mccoy-taliese-fuage-practice-saints-news-headlines-11-26-2026). TE Juwan Johnson (hamstring, wrist) did not practice Wednesday, while CB Martin Emerson Jr. (concussion) practiced in full [Tina Howell](https://www.canalstreetchronicles.com/new-orleans-saints-injuries/118542/wednesdays-saints-vs-bengals-injury-report-erik-mc-coy-and-taliese-fuaga-return-to-practice).

Week 12 Bengals Outlook: Kellen Moore and DC Brandon Staley open installation for the Cincinnati Bengals (7-3, CIN -10, HC Zac Taylor, OC Dan Pitcher & DC Al Golden (Road Test))—a unit ranked #1 in Passing Yards / Game (297.1 yds) as New Orleans prepares for a pivotal NFC matchup [neworleanssaints.com Official](https://www.neworleanssaints.com/news/new-orleans-saints-defense-amid-best-stretch-will-face-formidable-bengals-offense) [PFF](https://x.com/PFF/status/2125813535372435570).

NFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 3-7 (3rd in NFC South • #14 Seed in NFC), New Orleans carries a 8.1% postseason projection, 8% NFC South division title mark, and 0% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [Tina Howell](https://www.canalstreetchronicles.com/new-orleans-saints-discussion/118441/csc-reacts-results-whats-the-biggest-obstacle-preventing-the-saints-from-becoming-playoff-contenders).

Around the Beat: Welcome to today’s roundup of New Orleans Saints and NFL news [Caleb Yaccarino](https://www.canalstreetchronicles.com/new-orleans-saints-news/118562/new-orleans-saints-news-the-team-is-finally-getting-healthy).

Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, New Orleans ranks #21 in Points / Game (21.5), #23 in Points Allowed / Game (25.7), #29 in Turnover Differential (-8), giving Kellen Moore and Brandon Staley a clear benchmark ahead of Sun, Nov 29, 12:00 PM CST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the Cincinnati Bengals [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/preview?gameId=401873087).
